categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies `BufferedWriter` in `src/streams.h` to clear pending buffer bytes before writing, avoiding destructor aborts during exception unwinding.
categories.rationale: Prevents `std::terminate` during stream destruction on write failures by ensuring `BufferedWriter` handles flush errors safely. The stream primitive's implicit `noexcept` destructor was terminating the process rather than allowing callers to handle write exceptions cleanly.

categories.name: validation
categories.rationale: Ensures disk write failures in block storage trigger clean fatal error handling rather than an abrupt process abort via `std::terminate`. As shown in the reproduction script, short writes to block files previously crashed the process instead of cleanly reporting storage errors.
